activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P1
activities.objective: Will be curious to know the story via narrating. / Will be able tell the title and moral of the story
activities.level_1: Listens but not very attentively. Understands, not completely
activities.level_2: Is excited & understands the story, but does not answer questions
activities.level_3: is able to answer questions related to story

activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P2
activities.objective: Will be able to correlate the story (Colors, charaters, place, shapes) with their life learnings / Will be able to get the sequnce of the story via book/flash cards.
activities.level_1: Is following the book reading, but slow in responding
activities.level_2: Is excited in reading the book
activities.level_3: Is expressive of the understanding

activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P3
activities.objective: Will be so curious to watch the puppet story / Will be able to understand and recognize each puppet name
activities.level_1: Is able to understand but does not prompt
activities.level_2: is able to remember & prompts following others, but not spontaneously.
activities.level_3: is aware of the story and narrates spontaneously

activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P4
activities.objective: Will be expressive enough to tell the story and wait for the turn to tell their part of sequence.
activities.level_1: is able to comprehend a little but hardly prompts
activities.level_2: Is able to remember & prompts following others, but not spontaneously.
activities.level_3: is aware of the story and narrates spontaneously

activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P5
activities.objective: Will get to know the concept of role-play. Will develop their vocabulary skills.
activities.level_1: is interested to stand in front but doesn't enact
activities.level_2: is able to prompt but forgets/leave in between
activities.level_3: is able to act her whole part

activities.name: Tumi goes to park. P6
activities.objective: Will be confident enough to tell the story Will not have stage fear.
activities.level_1: is able to narrate the story but forgets to use props
activities.level_2: is aware of using props but forgets sequence
activities.level_3: is aware of the whole story and even narrates (use of flash card/puppets) the story in sequence
